attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"Elske traced the jagged scar on the vest's shoulder, a souvenir from one of their many hunts.","severity":"major","reason":"puts Elske at past hunts; the briefing never says she joined any, and it names only Bertram leading three hunts"},{"span":"the way he always stood between her and the worst of the world","severity":"minor","reason":"added detail about their shared past not in the briefing"},{"span":"his boisterous laugh","severity":"minor","reason":"invented trait detail not in briefing"},{"span":"the common room","severity":"minor","reason":"an unnamed room not in the briefing, though plausibly generic colony space"}],"voice":3,"clarity":4,"tone":3,"overall":3,"comment":"Competent scene that ends on resolve and uses Rook well, but it claims Elske went on \"one of their many hunts\", which puts her at past events the briefing does not support.
